verdict.rationale: Scheduling recurring jobs is a fair question for LocalAI, since it ships a built-in agent platform. However, nothing in the evidence documents cron-style or recurring scheduling of jobs, agents or workflows. The agent and MCP features and the interactive `local-ai chat` shell agent are one-off, on-demand capabilities, not recurring schedules.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
